_comment: Curated fields for docs/blocks.system.manifest.json. Mechanical fields come from package.json, the ESM export and examples/.
design_rules: the core has no renderer-specific knowledge
module examples name each configured system blocks and prefix returned controllers with block
colorVariation assigns part of the random range to colorArray; inversionVariation divides the remaining monochrome range
colorArray is consumer-owned and defaults empty; positive colorVariation requires user-supplied CSS colors
the library owns only regular and inverse; automatic user colors share one generic color state that colors only the block shell
custom block colors choose the higher-contrast neutral menu color from the system ink and paper tokens
a draggable block hover frame reuses the resolved block color
documentation examples choose CMY for block shells; block paper and consumer-rendered HTML, canvas and SVG content stay neutral
minimized blocks keep their configured grid area reserved for conflict-free restore
compact() is explicit vertical gap filling; it keeps placed blocks in their column and preserves the configured grid size
accessible menu labels follow the document language and remain configurable
blocks:reorder always exposes the same detail keys for pointer and keyboard input
blocks:change reports compact, minimize, restore and remove state changes
base block CSS defines states and scrolling but contains no animation
attach() always receives an explicit field
